test_title: PYST 19: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 1 6 4 5 6 6 4 7 4 4 2 4 7 4 3 1 9 2 4 3 6 9 7 8 2 7 1 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 1 6 4 5 6 6 4 7 4 4 2 4 7 4 3 1 9 2 4 3 6 9 7 8 2 7 1 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/788951002c40a50b0a47dab0dc081747a71d02411a1317fc9632538ca922627a.png] 

Thus, there are 5 even number,** **each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
